verdict.rationale: The RTX 5090 ships with a developer ecosystem (CUDA Toolkit, RTX SDKs), so versioned APIs with a deprecation policy is a fair question here. The evidence only mentions a release number ("CUDA 13.4") and contains no documented API versioning scheme or deprecation policy. The probe also found no OpenAPI spec, so the evidence does not show this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
